events.title: Scenario: AI-driven data centers elevating substation loading
events.summary: AI workload concentration may be increasing substation thermal and cycling stress near data-center hubs. This could raise near-term transformer demand and maintenance workload for system operators.

events.title: Scenario: Aging high-voltage fleet raises retrofit and spare-parts urgency
events.summary: Aging HV equipment may be moving several operators towards overlapping retrofit and replacement decisions. This clustering could stress manufacturing lead times and spare-parts availability.

events.title: Scenario: Onshore cable and HV equipment scaling signals partial import risk reduction
events.summary: Onshoring cable and HV equipment may relieve some import-related delays for regional projects, but material and standards dependencies could limit full de-risking.

events.title: Scenario: Modular substations and factory assembly begin shifting project schedules
events.summary: Modular, factory-assembled substations may lower on-site construction risk but shift pressures to factory throughput, standardization, and skilled installation capacity.

events.title: Scenario: BESS adoption at data centers as resiliency hedge changes grid service participation
events.summary: Data center adoption of BESS for resiliency may alter local demand patterns and create new equipment procurement paths, potentially relieving some distribution-level stress while adding separate supply-chain demand.

events.title: Scenario: Renewables integration increasing protection and automation upgrade needs
events.summary: Renewable penetration may be raising protection and automation upgrade demand, creating a new equipment and engineering workload for grid operators and OEMs.

events.title: Scenario: Material pressure on silicon steel and copper influencing transformer timelines
events.summary: Silicon steel and copper availability remain key upstream constraints on transformer production; recycling can mitigate but requires validation and standards alignment.

events.title: Scenario: Market uncertainty shifting procurement toward distributed resiliency
events.summary: Uncertain market and policy signals could redirect procurement toward distributed resiliency, easing some near-term capacity needs but potentially deferring essential long-lead grid investments.

events.title: Scenario: Predictive maintenance adoption shifting transformer failure profiles
events.summary: Predictive maintenance adoption may reduce certain transformer outages and shift procurement toward sensor networks and analytics platforms, creating parallel supply-chain and workforce demands.

events.title: Scenario: Interconnector and submarine-cable demand stressing manufacturing and port logistics
events.summary: Subsea interconnector interest could concentrate demand on submarine cable manufacturing and marine logistics, creating potential scheduling and cost pressures if projects cluster.
